hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'skill-management: python3 not found; SKILL.md structural validator will be unavailable until python3 is installed' >&2; exit 0; }; (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt" . && python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt"; }
